title: S3 bucket without server-side encryption
description: S3 buckets should encrypt objects at rest. A bucket with no server_side_encryption_configuration block relies on the account default, which may not exist. Standalone aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration resources are acknowledged but require graph correlation to attribute.

title: S3 bucket with public ACL
description: Bucket ACLs granting public-read, public-read-write, or authenticated-read expose objects beyond the account.

title: S3 bucket without versioning
description: Versioning protects against accidental deletion and overwrites and is required for reliable recovery. Provider default is disabled.

title: Public S3 exfiltration path
description: An S3 bucket is readable by the public internet through a bucket policy granting s3:GetObject to everyone, or a public ACL: a complete path exists from the internet to the bucket's data.

evidence.expected: private ACL with public access blocked

path.detail: anonymous requests from the public internet
bucket data is readable under the public ACL

title: S3 bucket without public access block
description: Without an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block enabling all four protections (block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, restrict_public_buckets), a single permissive ACL or policy can expose the bucket. Fail-safe: only a proven all-four-true block silences this rule.

evidence.actual: absent or not all four protections enabled
evidence.expected: public access block with all four settings = true

title: S3 bucket policy does not enforce TLS (SecureTransport)
description: Without an explicit Deny on aws:SecureTransport=false, bucket objects can be fetched over plaintext HTTP. Add a bucket policy statement denying s3:* when SecureTransport is false.

evidence.expected: bucket policy denying s3:* when SecureTransport is false

title: S3 bucket without server access logging
description: Server access logging records requests against the bucket, which is essential for audit and incident response.

title: S3 bucket without lifecycle configuration
description: Hygiene: S3 buckets should define lifecycle rules to transition or expire objects, controlling long-term storage costs. Add a lifecycle_rule block or an aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration resource.
